description: Tasks template for modernization plan. Generate this file alongside plan.md to track individual migration tasks.

tasks.description: Upgrade Spring Boot from 2.7.18 to 4.x, including Java upgrade to 25 and Jakarta EE migration (javax.* to jakarta.*)
tasks.reason: Java 8 and Spring Boot 2.x are end-of-life for internal use per Acme Corp policy. Targets require Java 25 and Spring Boot 4.x. This is also a prerequisite for all subsequent transform tasks.
tasks.requirements: Upgrade Spring Boot from 2.7.18 to the latest 4.x release. This includes upgrading Java to 25, Spring Framework to 7.x, and migrating all javax.* imports to jakarta.*. Maven build and all existing unit tests must pass after the upgrade. WAR packaging must be preserved until containerization task.

tasks.description: Migrate all SLF4J logging and System.out.println calls to InternalLogger (com.acme.logging.InternalLogger)
tasks.reason: SLF4J (@Slf4j, LoggerFactory), Logback, and System.out.println are prohibited by Acme Corp policy because they lack trace-context integration. InternalLogger is the sole approved logging framework and injects trace IDs, team tags, and structured JSON.
tasks.requirements: Replace all usages of @Slf4j, LoggerFactory, log.debug/info/warn/error, and System.out.println / System.err.println in all Java source files with the InternalLogger (com.acme.logging.InternalLogger). Remove any SLF4J, Logback, or Log4j dependencies that are no longer required after the migration. Do not introduce any new logging frameworks.

tasks.description: Migrate all RestTemplate usage to the ServiceMesh SDK (com.acme.mesh.ServiceMesh) for backend service-to-service communication
tasks.reason: RestTemplate is deprecated and prohibited by Acme Corp policy because it bypasses the service mesh layer. All service-to-service communication must go through the ServiceMesh SDK, which provides automatic circuit breaking, mTLS termination, distributed tracing, and canary routing.
tasks.requirements: Replace all RestTemplate beans and usages in AppConfig, BackendApiService, InventoryApiService, and VendorApiService with the ServiceMesh SDK (com.acme.mesh.ServiceMesh). Remove the RestTemplate @Bean in AppConfig. Ensure all outbound HTTP calls to the backend API use the ServiceMesh SDK. Managed Identity must be used for authentication between services.

tasks.description: Containerize the SupplyChain Frontend application using the approved Microsoft OpenJDK 25 base images
tasks.reason: The application must be containerized to deploy to Azure Container Apps (ACA). The existing Dockerfile uses the outdated Java 8 Tomcat base image which must be replaced with the approved images per Acme Corp targets.
tasks.requirements: Update the Dockerfile to use a multi-stage build. Build stage must use mcr.microsoft.com/openjdk/jdk:25-ubuntu. Runtime stage must use mcr.microsoft.com/openjdk/jdk:25-distroless. Package the application as a JAR (not WAR) for the containerized deployment. Expose port 8081.

tasks.description: Deploy the SupplyChain Frontend to Azure Container Apps (ACA)
tasks.reason: Azure Container Apps is the default target compute platform for all Java services in the supply chain system per the Acme Corp replatform strategy.
tasks.requirements: Deploy the containerized SupplyChain Frontend application to Azure Container Apps. Use Managed Identity for service-to-service authentication. Ensure the backend API URL is configured via environment variables or Azure App Configuration rather than hardcoded values.
